text:
as a ovillo of hebras of seda estampado contra a pared

she bordea the tapia of a sendero in the jardines of Kensington

and is goes muriendo poco a poco

of a especie of anemia emocional.


And for there is pasea a chusma

of hijos of the miseria, inmundos, vigorosos, inextinguibles.

they heredarán the earth.


she is the final of the estirpe.

his aburrimiento is exquisito and excesivo.

Le gustaría that alguien fuese a hablarle,

and casi has miedo of that I

cometa esa indiscreción.
